items.description: Vice-President JD Vance is among US officials expected to take part in negotiations resuming on Saturday in Oman.

items.title: Spain battles to contain one of its deadliest wildfires as at least 12 killed
items.description: At least four Britons are believed to be among the victims of the blaze, which left another 23 people missing.

items.title: Meet the crypto billionaires building a world where money buys you a vote
items.description: They think democracy has run its course - so they're setting up their own nations instead.

items.title: East Asia braces for destructive typhoon as landslides kill 15 in Philippines
items.description: Heading for Taiwan and south-eastern China, the 1,000 km-wide Bavi is forecast to be one of the strongest storms in decades.

items.title: The photo that shows who's really on top in Le Pen's party
items.description: Thirty-year-old Jordan Bardella had been groomed for success as France's next hard-right leader. He will now have to wait longer.

items.title: Meta pulls new AI image feature after days of backlash
items.description: Meta's release this week of an AI feature that let people alter Instagram content drew swift blowback.

items.title: Apple sues OpenAI, its employees claiming theft of trade secrets
items.description: Apple said in a Friday lawsuit that OpenAI’s nascent hardware business is “rotten to its core.”

items.title: New dinosaur species as long as cricket pitch discovered in Thailand
items.description: The plant-eating dinosaur, named Uragasaurus kalasinensis, is thought to have lived about 150 million years ago.

items.title: Small plane crash in Bahamas kills 10 people
items.description: The country's prime minister called the crash, on the country's independence day, a tragedy.

items.title: Man nearly sucked out of window mid-air on Ryanair plane, passengers say
items.description: The man's wife held onto his legs for around five minutes to stop him from being sucked out, officials say.

items.title: Man fatally shot by ICE in Houston was not intended target, DHS says
items.description: Immigration agents were looking for a different person when they shot Lorenzo Salgado Araujo during a traffic stop, officials say.

items.title: Zulu king expresses regret after video captures tirade against his wife
items.description: In the footage widely shared in South Africa, King Misuzulu threatens to physically assault his wife and accuses her of cheating.
